justification: Adds a named early-access grant mechanism so the payment-gated conveyancing report can be sent to founding members and tested internally before Stripe billing exists: an ?access=<code> link validated server-side against CONVEYANCING_ACCESS_CODES unlocks the existing full-PDF download CTA.

pre_impl.existing_data: Explore audit confirmed no entitlement or access-code infrastructure exists anywhere: lib/report-token.ts is an HMAC anti-injection guard not an entitlement, the satellite routes use an ADMIN_SECRET header per-route, and Stripe promo codes only matter once checkout is wired (it is not — the live UI shows a waitlist button). The free conveyancing check already mints a report_id and the paid download CTA component already exists and works when given one.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Assumed the conveyancing report was actively payment-gated; in reality the checkout route is dormant and the frontend gate trusts a ?payment=success query param with no server verification, and the PDF generate route is unauthenticated. The grant mechanism therefore adds the first server-checked access decision this product has; hardening the generate route itself is flagged as follow-up, not silently bundled.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Reuses the existing ConveyancingPaidDownloadCTA, the existing free-check report_id, and the existing PDF generate path unchanged. New code is only the pure validator, one small validate route, and the unlock wiring — no new tables, no new entitlement framework, matching the outreach RULE 4 decision that comps stay a spreadsheet plus codes until billing lands.

functions.name: isValidAccessCode
functions.input: a candidate code string and the comma-separated env list, both possibly null or undefined or non-string
functions.output: true only when the trimmed code exactly matches one trimmed non-empty entry in the list
functions.if_none: any missing, non-string, empty or whitespace input returns false, so an unset env var fails closed and no code is ever valid by default

functions.name: POST /api/reports/conveyancing/access
functions.input: JSON body with a code field of unknown type from an untrusted client
functions.output: 200 with valid true or false only, never the configured code list; 400 on bad JSON, missing code or codes over 100 chars
functions.if_none: invalid JSON or a non-string code returns 400 before any env comparison, and a valid hit logs the named code for the usage trail

functions.name: ConveyancingTool grant unlock effect
functions.input: the access query param or a previously stored sessionStorage code from an earlier page load
functions.output: accessGranted state set true only after the server validates the code; invalid codes are removed from sessionStorage
functions.if_none: no param and no stored code returns early with no fetch; a network failure leaves the page in the normal free state with the waitlist button

values.value: json.valid from the access validation response
values.if_missing: optional-chained json?.valid treats a malformed response as invalid, so the page stays in the free tier rather than unlocking

values.value: result.report_id from the free instant check response
values.if_missing: result?.report_id ?? null keeps unlockedReportId null so the download CTA simply does not render — no crash and no CTA with a broken id

queries: N/A — no database queries in this change; validation is a pure env-var string comparison

break_it.scenario: Someone brute-forces or guesses grant codes against the public validate route
break_it.what_happens: Codes are random-hex-suffixed and capped at 100 chars; a wrong code returns valid false with no hint and the response never echoes the configured list, so guessing yields nothing enumerable
break_it.how: random suffixes, exact-match-only comparison, no code list in any response, and a jest test asserts the list is never echoed
break_it.repro: curl -X POST /api/reports/conveyancing/access -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"code":"guess-01"}' and observe valid false

break_it.scenario: CONVEYANCING_ACCESS_CODES is unset in an environment, for example a preview deploy before the var was added
break_it.what_happens: isValidAccessCode returns false for every code so the page silently behaves as the normal free tier with the waitlist button; the founder link appears dead rather than granting access
break_it.how: fail-closed is the intended direction (never accidental free access); the jest test for the unset env var pins it, and docs/CONFIGURATION.md documents the preview-env requirement
break_it.repro: npx jest --testPathPattern=conveyancing-access -t 'env var is unset' or unset the var locally and load /reports/conveyancing?access=any-code

break_it.scenario: A grant is revoked while the grantee still has the code cached in sessionStorage from an earlier visit
break_it.what_happens: The next page load re-validates against the server, gets valid false, removes the stored code and renders the ordinary free tier, so revocation takes effect on next load rather than persisting client-side forever
break_it.how: every page load re-validates server-side; the invalid branch explicitly deletes the sessionStorage entry
break_it.repro: load the page with a valid ?access code, remove that code from the env var, redeploy, reload the page and confirm the waitlist button is back

break_it.scenario: The free check response arrives without a report_id while a grant is active
break_it.what_happens: unlockedReportId stays null because the derivation optional-chains result report_id, so the download CTA is not rendered and the user sees results plus waitlist copy instead of a CTA that would post an undefined id
break_it.how: null-safe derivation keeps the CTA unrendered rather than generating with a missing id
break_it.repro: mock /api/satellite/conveyancing to omit report_id in a jest DOM test or devtools override, run a check with a granted session and observe no download panel

post_merge.db_reset: none — this change touches no database anywhere
post_merge.secrets: set CONVEYANCING_ACCESS_CODES in Vercel for Preview and Production before testing; the named comp list itself stays in the private spreadsheet per outreach RULE 4, never in git
post_merge.manual_verify: on the PR preview open /reports/conveyancing?access=<internal code>, run an address, confirm the early-access download panel renders and the PDF generates via Railway; then confirm ?access=wrong-code shows the plain free tier
